detail.longDescription: Someone sends a 200-page PDF and you need pages 4 to 9 of it. PDFCheetah splits a PDF four different ways: extract the pages you select, split by range, separate every page into its own file, or divide at boundaries you set yourself. It all happens on your own device. The document is never uploaded, and there is no sign-up. https://www. pdfcheetah.com/split-pdf # PDF # Privacy # Productivity # WebApps
